status: Provisional. Set by the engineer before the first run of this test and before any result of it was read. Not derived from the literature and not validated. Changing a number after a run is an amendment and has to be said so in the report.

kernel_emulation.note: Gaussian blur and white noise. Not a reconstruction kernel.

pass.KA2_gate_against_truth: report only. If KA1 fails while the gate verdict is PASS or PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, or KA1 passes while the gate verdict is FAIL, that disagreement is a finding.

KA3_new_nodules.false_alarms: report only, rigid grid beside deformable frame. The detector is a plain smoothed difference image; a high count is a finding about that detector, not a pass or a fail of the registration.

KA4b_core_candidate.meaning: Candidate decision measure: the aerated mass of the lung core, deeper than 4 mm inside the label, which does not include the rim where blur moves tissue density across the label edge. It is judged on the same build, from the arrays: the change in the number caused by the emulated kernel alone (final against before-kernel) has to stay within the points given. Passing makes it eligible to replace the whole-label mass in the lung-volume step; it does not replace it by itself.

reading: PASS on a part means the pipeline met the number on a case built to be easier than a real pair. FAIL on a part is a finding about the pipeline. Nothing here is a clinical validation.
